verdict.rationale: incident.io explicitly has a 'Workflows' engine that triggers automations on incident events (e.g., auto-publishing status page updates when an incident changes), confirming a condition-based automation engine exists, and follow-ups show related task automation constructs. However, the evidence pack lacks direct documentation of reminders or arbitrary field-change automations as workflow triggers, only the status-page publishing example is concretely evidenced. missing for 10: doc pages showing reminder workflows, field-update workflows, or a full workflow-builder overview with condition/trigger types beyond status-page publishing.
